title: scope.decision/1
description: What a rule did to one request. A rule that does not match a request records nothing; a rule that matched records one decision with the reason it had, whether it applied the change (live) or only computed it (dry run).

rule.description: the rule's id in the policy

mode.description: the effective mode the rule ran in on this request

outcome.description: applied: the change went out; would_apply: computed and discarded (dry run); skipped: matched but excluded (the install's environment, or a kind this sensor version does not implement); errored: the rule threw and the original answer was served

reason.description: the same wording live and dry run, so the counters compare
